title: useIsMobile resize listener never throttled/debounced
reasoning: Every window resize event triggers a setState call. On rapid resize (e.g., user dragging window border), this can cause dozens of re-renders per second, degrading performance. Standard practice is to debounce or throttle resize handlers.
reproduction:
1. Open /lindsay on desktop
2. Rapidly resize browser window
3. Observe performance panel shows many re-renders
4. On slower devices, UI may lag during resize
recommendation: Wrap the resize handler in a debounce (150-200ms) or throttle function. Libraries like lodash provide these, or implement a simple debounce using setTimeout.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests exist. Performance regression tests would require measuring render counts during simulated resize events.
suggestedRegressionTest: Performance test: simulate 50 rapid resize events within 1 second, assert state updates <= 10 times (confirming debounce/throttle active).
